channel.title: Workloads on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Workloads on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Workload
item.description: This section describes how to create an application workload. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Refer to Parameter Description to set the workload parameters. Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project Management permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: View Workload List
item.description: This section describes how to view the application workloads list. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project View permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project View permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: View Workload Details
item.description: This section describes how to view workload details. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project View permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project View permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: Edit Workload Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit workload information. You can edit the alias and description of a workload. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a created workload. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace.

item.title: Adjust the Number of Pod Replicas
item.description: This section describes how to adjust the number of pod replicas for a workload. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project Management permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: Stop Workloads
item.description: This section describes how to stop a workload. Warning This operation will scale the number of running pod replicas in the workload to 0, which will interrupt the business running in the workload. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.

item.title: Edit Workload Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit the settings of a created workload. After a workload is created, you can edit its update strategy, containers, storage, pod graceful termination, and pod scheduling rules. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace.

item.title: Delete Workloads
item.description: This section describes how to delete a workload. Warning This operation will delete the workload and all pods managed by it. The business running in the workload will be interrupted. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace.
